English: Greetings.
You're not with the tax office, are you?
Certainly not!
Once the sale goes through, it shouldn't be my concern any longer.
Assuming everything goes to plan, of course.
Hello there.
Is there something I can help you with?
No, thank you! I'll best be going.
Lady Unterwald?
Are you still here?
Hello there.
Sorry, I'm not buying whatever it is you're selling.
It's you again!
I should probably leave you to it.
How can I find out the idol gesture?
Keep an eye out for clues about the gestures Lady Unterwald might make.

Pinch a napkin from the bar, apply some surgical spirit to it, and then figure out what's under that painting.

Seems like it's got something to do with Lady Unterwald, probably some mushy stuff.
I need another hint about the idol engraving.
Have you checked everything in the lobby outside Lady Unterwald's room?

The model railway in the lobby was dedicated to Lady Unterwald.

He's pretty unresponsive after drinking that Rosebud, you'll need to snap him out of his stupor.
I need another hint to get Mr Masson talking.
A shock to his system may temporarily bring him to his senses.
I need another hint to get Mr Masson talking.
If Mr Masson drank something potent enough, it may sober him up enough to vote!
I need another hint to get Mr Masson talking.
Top up Mr Masson's glass with the spicy soup from the kitchen. I bet that'd get him talking again!
I need to get the hearing horn repaired, any ideas?
Ask the band about the hearing horn, I'm sure they'd be happy to help.
I need to win at the knife game, but he's too good!
Byron is skilled with a knife, but perhaps you could even the playing field.
I need another hint about the knife game.
You have the knife, right? It's slippery business, but perhaps you could tamper with it.
I need another hint about the knife game.
If you can loosen Byron's grip on that knife, he'd surely slip up!
I need another hint about the knife game.
Mix the hand cream with the melted butter to create a slippery concoction. Then apply that to the knife!
The band repaired the horn for me, now what?
Nice work. You should return the hearing horn to Arista now.
How can I get Arthur out of his room?
He's probably neck deep in paperwork, can you tamper with his room to get him out?
I need another hint about distracting Arthur.
If the lights went out, he'd probably struggle to get anything done.
I need another hint about distracting Arthur.
There's an electrical panel in the sleeper carriage, open that up and see what you can do.
I need to get back into my room, what should I do?
If the door isn't an option, then the next best thing would be to get in through the window.
I need another hint about getting back in my room.
You could climb outside the train, but you wouldn't want to do it without the right footwear!
I need another hint about getting back in my room.
You'll need some proper suction to stay on top of the train. Think on your feet, Herman!
I need another hint about getting back in my room.
If you could make a set of suction boots, that would provide enough adhesion to safely walk along the carriage roof.
I need another hint about getting back in my room.
See if you can find a plunger or two. You could use them to whip up a pair of suction boots!
I need another hint about getting back in my room.
There's a plunger in the kitchen, and another in the bathroom! You could use them to whip up a pair of suction boots!
I have the plunger boots, what now?
Get to the back of the train and climb that ladder!
I'll take it from here, thanks.
Are you still not performing on stage?
Ah, we'll probably get back up there eventually.
I'm still feeling mighty demoralised, personally!
Your true-blue determination was truly inspiring, however.
Are you saying I managed to inspire you?
Too right! You took that knife like a champ.
Barely batted an eye before you passed out!
Say, I reckon a new song's a-brewing!
Yeah, I can feel it!
A song about my bravery, you mean?
Yeah, Nah! Listen fellas, how about ''Butterfinger Blues''?
That's not bad. I was thinking ''Gutterblade Groove''?
''Slippin' Steel Symphony''?
Yeah! Now you're talking!
How's that song coming along?
The creative juices are flowing now!
It definitely has legs, I can see the potential!
Yeah, right! It's gonna be a ripper of a song!
Where did you learn about Knifey Stab Stab?
From me ma, of course! We used to play it all the time back home.
It was a riot! A real bonding moment, ya know!
Would you believe that's the first time anyone's got hurt playing 'Knifey Stab Stab'?
I do find that hard to believe.
Nah, yeah! Honest!
Just a couple scratches here and there, of course!
Could you have a look at this horn? It's broken.
Crikey, Is this a hearing aid?
It seems to produce a sound, regardless.
Not any more, check out the reed on this! It's knackered mate.
I reckon you'll need a replacement reed.
Do you have a spare? It's rather urgent.
I've only got the one, and I need it for my sax!
Couldn't I just borrow the reed? I'll bring it back!
You know it goes in your mouth, right? I don't think so.
I tell ya what, how about another round of ‘Knifey, Stab, Stab'?
Uhh... I don't think that's such a good ide-
If you can beat me at ‘Knifey, Stab, Stab', we'll hand it over.
Byron, what about my sax? I need it!
The man said it was urgent, and we're not using it right now.
I accept your challenge, let's play Knifey, Stab, Stab!
Good on ya, mate!
Uh... did you bring the knife back?
It was embedded in yer hand, last I saw it!
Not to worry, I have it right here!
I'd like a rematch!
Back for more, eh?
You must really want that mouthpiece!
Fancy another round of Knifey, Stab, Stab?
This guy's a maniac!
You got what you wanted already!
We're just going to stick to card games from now on.
Do you have any leads on your missing set list?
Not yet, but we'll find them!
Don't worry, they always return to the scene of the crime.
I'll leave you to your game.
See ya around.
As the reigning champ, I'll go first.
Watch and learn!
Such speed!
Incredible control!
I'd like to see ya beat that!
Alright, here goes nothing.
You'll have to do better than that.
That was even slower than last time!
Unlucky, mate! Better luck next time.
If I can't win playing by their rules, it's time to mix things up.
He's so fast!
She's a slippery one!
He's still got everything under cont-
Woahh, Nelly!
*Gasp*
*Gasp*
CRIKEY!
That nearly went through me bleedin' hand!
I think we need to stop playing this game, Byron!
So...does that mean I win?
You got me on a technicality, but it's fair dinkum.
Fix the man's horn, he's won it fair and square.
Fine, give it here. I'll replace the reed.
There we go.
Most appreciated.
Right, I think we should call it quits for now.
Did Mr Liu come back in here?
Jian? He was here earlier, but didn't stay long.
Seemed to ask a lot of questions about Lady Unterwald.
What kind of questions?
Her likes, dislikes, that kind of thing.
Between you and me, I think he's smitten!
Yeah I saw him, he seemed pretty annoyed.
He had the doctor in tow, I think he was trying to calm Jian down.
They went down the carriage, towards Lady Unterwald's quarters.
Thanks!
What can you tell me about the missing idol?
It's modelled after Lady Unterwald's own hands, I remember that much.
We haven't convened a formal meeting for some time, but I'm sure it'll turn up!
Is there anything else you can tell me about the missing idol?
Let's see. I remember the idol feeling heavy in my hands.
There was definitely some weight to it!
Is this the hand idol you were looking for?
I believe that might be it! Hand it over to the fine gentlemen at the table.
What is this place, exactly?
We are... THE ORDER OF IDLE HANDS.
The name is appropriate. You can't get anything done!
Now, now, Mr Liu. We're all trying our best.
The Order Of Idle Hands?
Think of us as the guiding hand of the Unterwald empire.
Listen, I don't do cults. Not again, not after last time.
We exist only to protect Lady Unterwald's interests, and actively work to keep things running smoothly.
I see. It all seems a bit... theatrical?
Yes, well... admittedly, we might have got a bit carried away.
What does Lady Unterwald think of the Order?
We decided it would be best if Lady Unterwald stayed unaware of our activities.
Don't you think all this subterfuge risks undermining her?
I want to be clear that Lady Unterwald still runs the show, we only wish to point her in the right direction.
I took a risk bringing you here, detective. I trust that you can be discreet? For all our sakes?
Hmm.
What's Jian Liu doing here?
Jian is one of us, or at least he was. I thought he'd left our order some time ago.
Regardless, he's called for a formal meeting and we must abide.
Never mind!
See you around, detective.
How can I get into Arthur's quarters?
Hm, maybe I shouldn't entrust such an important task to you.
I can do it, I just need a gentle reminder!
There's a fusebox in the sleeper carriage. You might be able to lure him out that way!
Understood!
And try to be discreet, will you? For heaven's sake.
This seems rather underhanded, perhaps we should just come clean?
Don't you start getting all soft on me now, detective!
It's a temporary measure, we just need to tie up these loose ends.
What about Jian's contact, aren't they going to be suspicious?
If you do your job properly, she'll be none the wiser!
I'm not so sure about this, Lady Unterwald!
You keep your mouth closed about this, Herman!
Whatever your feelings on the matter, we don't know who's listening!
It was an accident, you have to believe me!
Do you think the authorities would find your story believable?
Hm, perhaps not.
I think I should get on with it.
Make sure you get the job done!
What's next for Balboa Swing?
Hmm. I don't put an awful lot of faith in planning, myself.
More often than not it seems you'll just end up disappointed.
I'm happy to keep making hay while the sun shines.
Could you have a look at this horn? It's broken.
I wouldn't know anything about that, you'd be better off asking the band.
I really need that mouthpiece!
You're not winning on skill alone, looks like you'll need to elevate your chances!
Do you think you could put in a good word for me with Beverly Moore?
I can certainly try!
She's not so easily persuaded, I think she prefers to go with her gut.
Are you going to sing yet?
I'll sing alright, but I need my boys on stage with me.
When do you think you'll be ready, boys?
When do you think you'll be ready, boys?
Sorry Suze, we're still fuming about our missing set list!
Sorry Suze, we're still fuming about our missing set list!
Looks like it's going to be a while.
Do you think you'll return to the stage soon?
Sorry Suze, we're still working out this new song!
Looks like it's going to be a while.
